matthew.1.p1.b1.text: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:

matthew.1.p1.b2.text: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers.

matthew.1.p1.b3.text: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth,

matthew.1.p1.b4.text: and Jesse the father of David the king.

matthew.1.p2.b1.text: David was the father of Solomon by Uriah’s wife,

matthew.1.p2.b3.text: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

matthew.1.p3.b1.text: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,

matthew.1.p3.b2.text: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary,

matthew.1.p3.b3.text: of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

matthew.1.p3.b4.text: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, … and fourteen from the exile to the Christ.

matthew.1.p4.b1.text: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about:

matthew.1.p4.b2.text: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together,

matthew.1.p4.b3.text: she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.

matthew.1.p5.b1.text: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man

matthew.1.p5.b2.text: and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly,

matthew.1.p5.b3.text: he resolved to divorce her quietly.

matthew.1.p6.b1.text: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream

matthew.1.p6.b2.text: Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid

matthew.1.p6.b3.text: to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.

matthew.1.p6.b4.text: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”

matthew.1.p7.b1.text: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel”

matthew.1.p7.b3.text: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him, and embraced Mary as his wife.

matthew.1.p8.b1.text: But he had no union with her

matthew.1.p8.b2.text: until she gave birth to a Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.
